dialogue.origin: こんにちは　相談員です。ご相談にお越しいただきありがとうございます。今日はどのようなご相談でしょうか。
dialogue.content: Hello, I'm the counselor. Thank you for coming in for a consultation. What can I help you with today?

dialogue.origin: よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.content: Thank you for seeing me.

dialogue.origin: こちらこそ。宜しくおねがいします。
dialogue.content: The pleasure is all mine. I look forward to our session.

dialogue.origin: 実家のことで頭を悩ませています。
dialogue.content: I'm troubled about matters concerning my family home.

dialogue.origin: 家事のことで悩んでいらっしゃるのですね。
dialogue.content: So, you're feeling troubled about household matters, is that right?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: お話しやすいところからで構わないので、どのような点でお悩みでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Please feel free to start wherever you're comfortable. What specific things are you concerned about?

dialogue.origin: 兄が家を継ぐ予定だったのですが
dialogue.content: My older brother was supposed to take over as head of the family, but...

dialogue.origin: お兄様が継ぐ予定だったのに？
dialogue.content: Your brother was supposed to take over, but...?

dialogue.origin: はい 兄が体調を崩し思うようにからだが動かず
dialogue.content: Yes. He fell ill, and his body doesn't move the way he'd like.

dialogue.origin: 両親に負担をかけているのが心苦しく
dialogue.content: It pains me that he's placing a burden on our parents.

dialogue.origin: 私は何ができるのだろうと
dialogue.content: I keep wondering what I can do.

dialogue.origin: お兄様の体調が、ご両親に負担をかけてしまうのですね。
dialogue.content: So your brother's health condition is placing a burden on your parents, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 本来であれば
dialogue.content: Under normal circumstances...

dialogue.origin: 本来であれば？
dialogue.content: Under normal circumstances?

dialogue.origin: 兄が継いでいたので
dialogue.content: My brother would have taken over.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: そういうことですね。もしよろしければ、ご年齢と性別教えていただけないでしょうか
dialogue.content: I see. If you don't mind, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Sure.

dialogue.origin: 私は30代後半 女です。
dialogue.content: I'm a woman in my late thirties.

dialogue.origin: 兄が元気であれば
dialogue.content: If my brother were healthy,

dialogue.origin: 両親に楽をさせてあげられるのに
dialogue.content: he could let our parents take it easy.

dialogue.origin: お兄様はそんなによろしくないのですか？
dialogue.content: Is your brother's condition that serious?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: ご心配ですよね。
dialogue.content: That must be very worrying for you.

dialogue.origin: 心配ではあります
dialogue.content: It is worrying.

dialogue.origin: 一方で、ご両親に楽をさせてあげたかったんですね。
dialogue.content: At the same time, you wanted your parents to be able to relax and take it easy.

dialogue.origin: そうですね
dialogue.content: That's right.

dialogue.origin: ずっと働きっぱなしで
dialogue.content: They've been working non-stop,

dialogue.origin: お休みもほとんどなかったので
dialogue.content: and they've barely had any days off.

dialogue.origin: ああ、ご両親様はずっと働きっぱなしでいらっしゃったのですね。
dialogue.content: Ah, so your parents have been working constantly all this time.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: そんなご両親を、楽にさせてあげたい気持ちなんですね。
dialogue.content: And you have this desire to let them finally have an easier life.

dialogue.origin: 兄が継げばゆっくりできると思っていました
dialogue.content: I thought they could finally relax if my brother took over.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。お兄様は継ぐことが出来ないご病状なのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I see. Is his medical condition preventing him from taking over?

dialogue.origin: できないことはないのですが
dialogue.content: It's not that he can't, but...

dialogue.origin: 体調に変動があります
dialogue.content: his condition fluctuates.

dialogue.origin: ご心配ですね。体調に変動があるのですね。
dialogue.content: That must be worrying. So his condition fluctuates.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: お兄様とは、家を継ぐことについてご相談されているのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Have you discussed the matter of succession with your brother?

dialogue.origin: 兄は小さい頃から家を継ぐ人として育っていました
dialogue.content: My brother was raised from a young age to be the one to take over the family.

dialogue.origin: 周りもそう見ていました
dialogue.content: Everyone around us saw him that way, too.

dialogue.origin: ああ、そういうことですね。家を継ぐことは　大変なことなのですね。
dialogue.content: Ah, I see. Taking over the family responsibilities is a significant undertaking, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: 大変といえば大変ですが簡単ではないですね
dialogue.content: It's significant, yes. It's not simple.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。なにか稼業をされているのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I see. Is there a family business involved?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 提灯をつくっています
dialogue.content: We make paper lanterns.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。お父様は後継者として、お兄様に技術をお伝えになっていたということでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I see. So your father has been passing on the skills to your brother as his successor?

dialogue.origin: はいそうです
dialogue.content: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.origin: 時間の掛かることですので
dialogue.content: It takes a long time to learn.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね。日本の伝統ですよね。
dialogue.content: That's true. It's a Japanese tradition, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: もし兄ができないのであれば
dialogue.content: If my brother can't do it,

dialogue.origin: 私がしなくては
dialogue.content: then I feel like I have to.

dialogue.origin: という思いもあるのですが
dialogue.content: That's a thought I have, but...

dialogue.origin: あなたがやる　という思いなんですね。
dialogue.content: So you feel that you have to do it.

dialogue.origin: 現実問題厳しいです
dialogue.content: But realistically, it's difficult.

dialogue.origin: 厳しいのですね。それは技術の伝承ということでしょうか？
dialogue.content: It's difficult. Do you mean in terms of passing on the skills?

dialogue.origin: 私は自分の仕事がありますし
dialogue.content: I have my own job,

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。お仕事を持っていらっしゃるのですね。
dialogue.content: I see. So you have your own career.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 兄は辞めたわけではないので
dialogue.content: And it's not as though my brother has quit.

dialogue.origin: 私が出ていく状況ではないのですが
dialogue.content: so it's not really a situation where I need to step in, but...

dialogue.origin: 出ていく状況ではないけれども、ご心配なのですね。
dialogue.content: It's not a situation for you to step in, but you're still worried.

dialogue.origin: はい 両親の負担が大きくて
dialogue.content: Yes. The burden on my parents is heavy,

dialogue.origin: この先が心配です
dialogue.content: and I'm worried about the future.

dialogue.origin: ご両親様はおいくつでしょうか？
dialogue.content: How old are your parents?

dialogue.origin: 70歳です
dialogue.content: They're 70.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。ご心配ですよね。同居されているのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Thank you. That must be worrying. Are they all living together?

dialogue.origin: 両親と兄は同居しています
dialogue.content: My parents and my brother live together.

dialogue.origin: あなたは別に生活していらっしゃるのですね。失礼ですが、ご家族はいらっしゃいますか？
dialogue.content: So you live separately. May I ask, do you have a family of your own?

dialogue.origin: はいおります。
dialogue.content: Yes, I do.

dialogue.origin: 夫と子供が1人です
dialogue.content: I have a husband and one child.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。お子様もいらっしゃるのですね。ご家族とはこのことはお話されていますか？
dialogue.content: I see, so you have a child as well. Have you spoken about this with your family?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 旦那様は、なんておっしゃっていますか？
dialogue.content: What does your husband say?

dialogue.origin: 夫とはよく話します
dialogue.content: I often talk about it with my husband.

dialogue.origin: いつも
dialogue.content: He always...

dialogue.origin: 大変だなっと言っています
dialogue.content: says that it must be tough.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。ご相談にのってくださる旦那様、素敵ですね。
dialogue.content: I see. It's wonderful that you have a husband you can talk to about these things.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: 色々理解してくれます
dialogue.content: He's very understanding about many things.

dialogue.origin: いろいろと理解して下さるのですね。では、あなたのお仕事のことも？
dialogue.content: He's very understanding. Does that include your work as well?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 家事育児協力的です
dialogue.content: He's very cooperative with housework and childcare.

dialogue.origin: わぁ、すごいですね。家事育児を協力してくださるのですね。失礼ながらそのお年で、やってくださる旦那様は少ないのでは？
dialogue.content: Wow, that's amazing. He's cooperative with housework and childcare. Forgive me for saying, but it seems rare for a husband of that generation to be so involved, doesn't it?

dialogue.origin: そうですかね
dialogue.content: You think so?

dialogue.origin: 私よりも家事が得意です
dialogue.content: He's better at housework than I am.

dialogue.origin: 好きなんだと思います
dialogue.content: I think he enjoys it.

dialogue.origin: え？ますますスゴイですね。
dialogue.content: Oh? That's even more impressive.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: ご実家のことですが、提灯制作は、他に従業員はいらっしゃらないのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Regarding your family's business, are there any other employees involved in making the lanterns?

dialogue.origin: おります
dialogue.content: Yes, there are.

dialogue.origin: ベテランさんもいますが
dialogue.content: We have some veteran craftsmen, but...

dialogue.origin: やはり
dialogue.content: Still,

dialogue.origin: 父のあとは兄が継ぐとなっていまして
dialogue.content: it has been decided that my brother will succeed my father,

dialogue.origin: 大事なところは兄が引き継ぐようです
dialogue.content: and it seems my brother is supposed to take over the most important parts.

dialogue.origin: 大事なところとは？
dialogue.content: The important parts?

dialogue.origin: 提灯づくりの工程で
dialogue.content: In the lantern-making process,

dialogue.origin: 大事なところです
dialogue.content: the crucial steps.

dialogue.origin: 失礼しました
dialogue.content: My apologies.

dialogue.origin: 工程のすべてではなくて、カナメのようなところがあるんですね。
dialogue.content: So it's not the entire process, but there are certain key, pivotal parts.

dialogue.origin: 失礼ですが、お兄様にはお子様は？
dialogue.content: If I may ask, does your brother have any children?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Well,

dialogue.origin: 兄は独身です
dialogue.content: my brother is single.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。ではそういうこともあって後継者について悩まれるのですね。
dialogue.content: I see. So that's another reason you're concerned about a successor.

dialogue.origin: そうですね
dialogue.content: That's right.

dialogue.origin: せっかく両親が築きあげてきたので
dialogue.content: My parents have worked so hard to build this business,

dialogue.origin: 守ってもらいたい
dialogue.content: and I want to see it protected.

dialogue.origin: 守りたい　そういうお気持ちなんですね。
dialogue.content: You want to protect it—that's the feeling you have.

dialogue.origin: 複雑な気持ちです
dialogue.content: I have mixed feelings.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 複雑？
dialogue.content: Mixed feelings?

dialogue.origin: はい複雑です
dialogue.content: Yes, they're complicated.

dialogue.origin: 守っていきたい気持ちと、ご自身では継ぐことが出来ない　ことで板挟み？
dialogue.content: Are you caught between wanting to protect it and the fact that you can't take over yourself?

dialogue.origin: 両親のこと、兄のこと、稼業のこと色々考えると複雑です
dialogue.content: When I think about my parents, my brother, and the family business, it all feels so complicated.

dialogue.origin: 複雑っておかしいですか？
dialogue.content: Is it strange to feel so conflicted?

dialogue.origin: いえいえ複雑、おかしくありませんよ！
dialogue.content: No, not at all. It's not strange to feel conflicted.

dialogue.origin: でも、ちょっと分解して別々にお話うかがってもよいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: But, would it be okay if we tried to break it down and talk about each part separately?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: お兄様は　工程のカナメの部分のお仕事だけは継続していける、ご体調でしょうか？
dialogue.content: Regarding your brother, is his health stable enough for him to continue handling at least the pivotal parts of the process?

dialogue.origin: 体調に波がありまして
dialogue.content: His condition has its ups and downs,

dialogue.origin: 仕事することもままならないことがあります
dialogue.content: and there are times when he can't even work.

dialogue.origin: 波。。。失礼ですがお病気は精神的なものでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Ups and downs... Forgive me for asking, but is his illness mental in nature?

dialogue.origin: いいえ
dialogue.content: No.

dialogue.origin: 透析を始めたようです
dialogue.content: It seems he has started dialysis.

dialogue.origin: 腎臓ですね。それは大変ですね。
dialogue.content: His kidneys, then. That must be very difficult.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: お兄様ご自身はおいくつでしょうか？
dialogue.content: How old is your brother?

dialogue.origin: 45歳です
dialogue.content: He's 45.

dialogue.origin: まだお若いのにご心配ですね。
dialogue.content: That's still so young. It must be a great worry.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 朝起きるのが辛いときもあるみたいです
dialogue.content: It seems there are times when it's hard for him to even get up in the morning.

dialogue.origin: 朝辛い上に、お仕事の合間に、週3回くらい透析通院していらっしゃるということですね。
dialogue.content: So, on top of mornings being difficult, he has to go for dialysis about three times a week in between work, is that correct?

dialogue.origin: 夜寝ているときに
dialogue.content: While he's sleeping at night,

dialogue.origin: 治療ができるらしく
dialogue.content: apparently the treatment can be done,

dialogue.origin: 通院は週1回のようです
dialogue.content: so his hospital visits are apparently only once a week.

dialogue.origin: 腹膜透析をしていらっしゃるのですね
dialogue.content: So he must be on peritoneal dialysis.

dialogue.origin: 詳しいですね
dialogue.content: You know a lot about it.

dialogue.origin: 当たっているかどうかわかりませんが、たぶんそうかなと思いまして。友人がそうなので。
dialogue.content: I wasn't sure if I was right, but I thought that might be it. I have a friend who does it.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか
dialogue.content: Oh, I see.

dialogue.origin: 兄の辛さもわかるのですが
dialogue.content: I understand how hard it is for my brother, but...

dialogue.origin: それを見守っている、あなたも辛いですね。
dialogue.content: It must be hard on you, too, watching over all of this.

dialogue.origin: 何でこうなったのかな、と思います
dialogue.content: I just wonder how things ended up this way.

dialogue.origin: 何でこうなった？とは？
dialogue.content: 'How things ended up this way'?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Well,

dialogue.origin: 振り返ると
dialogue.content: looking back,

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 兄が両親の後を継ぐものとばかり思っていたにも関わらず
dialogue.content: even though I always just assumed my brother would take over from our parents,

dialogue.origin: 両親の負担は変わらない
dialogue.content: the burden on my parents hasn't changed.

dialogue.origin: 年老いて
dialogue.content: even as they've gotten older.

dialogue.origin: 年老いて、負担が変わらない。。。
dialogue.content: They're getting older, and yet the burden on them hasn't changed...

dialogue.origin: 父の動きも悪くなり
dialogue.content: My father's mobility is declining,

dialogue.origin: 少しずつ父の負担が減らせると
dialogue.content: and I thought his burden could be gradually reduced,

dialogue.origin: 思っていたのに
dialogue.content: that's what I thought, but...

dialogue.origin: 何も変わっていない
dialogue.content: nothing has changed.

dialogue.origin: だからといって
dialogue.content: But even so,

dialogue.origin: 私は何もできない
dialogue.content: there's nothing I can do.

dialogue.origin: 何もできない。。。
dialogue.content: 'Nothing you can do'...

dialogue.origin: ご両親様と、お兄様の3人で生活されているのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Are your parents and your brother the only three living together there?

dialogue.origin: あまり気持ちが伝わらないでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Am I not getting my feelings across very well?

dialogue.origin: はいそうです
dialogue.content: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.origin: いいえ、すごく気持ちわかります。
dialogue.content: No, not at all. I understand your feelings very well.

dialogue.origin: 私はすぐに家族を助けることも
dialogue.content: I can't just go and help my family right away,

dialogue.origin: ご実家は遠いのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Is your family home far away?

dialogue.origin: 手伝うこともできない
dialogue.content: and I can't even help out.

dialogue.origin: 離れています
dialogue.content: It's far away.

dialogue.origin: どれくらい？
dialogue.content: How far, roughly?

dialogue.origin: それは重要ですか？
dialogue.content: Is that important?

dialogue.origin: 半日あれば行き来はできます
dialogue.content: I can make a round trip in half a day.

dialogue.origin: たとえば週末だけでも行けるのかどうか、ちょっと気になりました。
dialogue.content: I was just wondering if it was a distance that you could travel, for example, just for the weekends.

dialogue.origin: そうですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: でも、ご両親様の普段の生活もご心配なのですよね？
dialogue.content: But you're also worried about your parents' daily lives, aren't you?

dialogue.origin: 行くだけであれば
dialogue.content: If it were just a matter of going there,

dialogue.origin: 生活の手伝いはできますね
dialogue.content: I could help with their daily life.

dialogue.origin: ご提案ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you for the suggestion.

dialogue.origin: そうですね。お仕事を持ちながら、大変だとは思いますが。。。
dialogue.content: Yes. I imagine it would be difficult while you have your own job, but...

dialogue.origin: いいえ
dialogue.content: No.

dialogue.origin: もし、それができたら、複雑な気持ちの中の、少しだけは軽減されるでしょうか？
dialogue.content: If you were able to do that, do you think it might alleviate some of those complicated feelings, even just a little?

dialogue.origin: そうですね
dialogue.content: I think so.

dialogue.origin: よかったです。そのことをご主人様と相談してみるのはいかがでしょうか。
dialogue.content: I'm glad to hear that. How about discussing that possibility with your husband?

dialogue.origin: 父の仕事の負担は変わりませんが
dialogue.content: It wouldn't change my father's workload,

dialogue.origin: 手助けできるところから
dialogue.content: but I can start by helping where I'm able.

dialogue.origin: 関わってみます
dialogue.content: I'll try to get more involved.

dialogue.origin: そうですね。できるところから。。。
dialogue.content: Yes. Starting with what you can...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: お父様、どんな顔されるでしょうか？
dialogue.content: How do you imagine your father will react?

dialogue.origin: それはどういうことですか？
dialogue.content: What do you mean by that?

dialogue.origin: お喜びになる顔とか　想像できますか？
dialogue.content: Can you picture his reaction? For example, him looking pleased?

dialogue.origin: 父は人に頼ろうとしないので
dialogue.content: My father doesn't like to rely on others,

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 私のことを心配してくれると思います
dialogue.content: I think he would worry about me.

dialogue.origin: 心配されてしまうんですね。そうですよね。親心でしょうか。。。
dialogue.content: So he would worry about you. Yes, that makes sense. It's a parent's instinct, perhaps...

dialogue.origin: 家のこと仕事があるのに大丈夫かって
dialogue.content: He'd ask if I'm okay, since I have my own home and job to worry about.

dialogue.origin: そうですね
dialogue.content: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.origin: でも、あなたには、すばらしいご主人様がおいでになりますよね。
dialogue.content: But you have a wonderful husband, don't you?

dialogue.origin: 良き理解者です
dialogue.content: He's a very good listener.

dialogue.origin: そうですね。すてきです。
dialogue.content: Yes, that's lovely.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: もし、週末だけでも家事のお手伝いができれば、お兄様の食生活にもいいのではないか　と思いました。お母さまお一人では大変でしょう。
dialogue.content: I was also thinking that if you could help with the housework, even just on weekends, it might be good for your brother's diet as well. It must be a lot for your mother to handle on her own.

dialogue.origin: そうですね
dialogue.content: That's true.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: （次は、伝承の技術の事をお話したかったのですが、時間になりました。本日はロールプレイをさせていただきありがとうございました。）
dialogue.content: (I wanted to talk about passing down the craft next, but our time is up. Thank you for doing this role-play session with me today.)

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: おつかれさまでした。感謝
dialogue.content: Thank you for your time. I appreciate it.

dialogue.origin: お世話になりました
dialogue.content: Thank you for your help.

dialogue.origin: どうぞ先にご退出ください。
